question_text: A transaction has decreased store A’s count but fails before increasing store B’s count. Describe how ROLLBACK should affect the transaction and the inventory total.
adaptation_rationale: Retains undo/recovery reasoning through explicit ROLLBACK; log/checkpoint recovery algorithms are not claimed as requirements.
solution: It undoes the uncommitted decrease at A. Neither half of the failed transfer remains, so the counts return to their prior consistent values and no item disappears from the inventory.
